teaser: You refold the paper napkin twice before setting it down, hands busy because sitting still at a funeral reception feels like admitting something. Life path 9 is the number of the one who comes to serve and then has to learn how to leave; ENFP is the type that falls for a room before it has learned anyone's name in it. Cross the two and you get someone who feels the grief of strangers as plainly as their own, and who is already working out how to make it easier for them, three people removed, before the thought is finished.
excerpt: Affection gets offered to a room before it narrows to one face.
